title: C: Struct Basics
description: Define a struct representing a Point with x and y coordinates, create an instance, and print its fields.

steps.title: Define and Use a Struct
steps.description: Define a `struct Point { int x; int y; };`. Create an instance `struct Point p = {3, 7}` and print 'Point: (3, 7)'.
